statements.subject: session
statements.description: If the currently selected newsgroup is valid, the current article number MUST be set to the next article in that newsgroup (that is, the lowest existing article number greater than the current article number). If successful, a response indicating the new current article number and the message-id of that article MUST be returned.
actions: set current article number to lowest existing article number greater than current
return success response with new current article number and message-id

statements.subject: session
statements.description: If the current article number is already the last article of the newsgroup, a 421 response MUST be returned.
statements.trigger: NEXT command received when current article is last article
